name: Medixio
description: AI agent that helps patients with chronic conditions track medical appointments, follow-ups, and medication schedules. Agent orchestration and LLM tooling built as a deployed product, not a notebook demo.

name: Perfect Binding
description: Desktop app that turns a PDF into a print-ready booklet. Saddle stitch, folded and glued, or perfect binding, with margin trimming and a sheet-by-sheet proof. Runs offline, the PDF never leaves the machine.

name: workout-pal
description: Local-first training PWA. An LLM drafts the split, the app runs it: guided workout mode, rest timers, per-set logging. No account, no backend, everything stays in the browser.

name: Learn Vim btw
description: An interactive, level-by-level Vim tutorial. Each lesson pairs a concept with a real in-browser Vim editor, so you practice motions, operators, and macros as you read.

name: Portfolio Site
description: This site. Astro 6, React islands, zero-JS static sections. Hacker-coded design system, written in the open.
